chapterInfo.content:
31
Ɔkasakyerɛ yɛ ma ɔhene
1Ɔhene Lemuel nsɛm; ɔkasakyerɛ a ne na de kyerɛkyerɛɛ no.
2Adɛn, me ba, na adɛn, me yafumma?
Na adɛn, me bɔhyɛ ba?
3 # Deut 17.17; 1 Ah 11.1 Mfa w’ahoɔden mma mmaa,
na mfa w’akwan nyɛ deɛ ɛsɛe ahemfo.
4 # Mmb 20.1 Ɛnsɛ ahemfo, Lemuel, ɛnsɛ ahemfo, sɛ wɔbɛnom nsa,
anaa atitire, sɛ wɔbɛdi nsaden akyire,
5na wɔannom na wɔn werɛ amfiri mmara a wɔahyɛ,
na wɔannane amanehunufoɔ nyinaa nsɛm ani.
6Fa nsaden ma deɛ ɔresɛeɛ,
ne bobesa ma awerɛhofoɔ.
7Ma no nnom na ne werɛ mfiri ne hia,
na wankae n’amaneɛ bio.
8 # Hiob 29.12, 15 Bue w’ano ma emum,
ma mma a wɔagya wɔn nyinaa asɛm.
9Bue w’ano, bu atɛntenenee,
na di mmɔborɔni ne ohiani asɛm.
Ɔyere pa ayeyie
10 # Mmb 12.4; 18.22 Ɔyepa, hwan na ɔbɛnya?
Nso ne boɔ sene nhwene pa koraa.
11Ne kunu akoma da ne so,
na siadeɛ adeɛ nhia no.
12Ɔyɛ no yie, na ɔnyɛ no bɔne biara,
ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
13Ɔdwene kuntu ne asaawa ho,
na ɔde ne nsa yɛ adwuma fɛ so.
14Ɔte sɛ odwadini ahyɛn,
ɔde n’aduane firi akyirikyiri ba.
15Adeɛ nnya nkyee a, na wɔasɔre,
na wama ne fiefoɔ aduane,
na wama ne mmaawa nnwuma.
16Ɔdwene afuo ho na ɔtɔ,
ɔde ne nsa ano aba yɛ bobeturo.
17Ɔde ahoɔden bɔ n’asene,
na ɔhyɛ n’abasa mu den.
18Ɔte ne dwumadie mu dɛ;
ne kanea nnum anadwo.
19Ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ɔtadua mu,
na ne nsateaa sɔ kyekye mu.
20Ɔbae ne nsam ma mmɔborɔni,
na ɔtene ne nsa ma ohiani.
21Ɔnsuro sukyerɛmma mma ne fiefoɔ,
na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa firafira atankɔkɔɔ.
22Wanwono mmommo afa,
ne ntoma yɛ nwera pa ne beredum.
23Wɔnim ne kunu kuro apono mu,
berɛ a ɔte asase no so mpanimfoɔ mu.
24 # Aso 9.39 Ɔpam nkamisaa na ɔtɔn,
na ɔde abɔsoɔ ma odwadini.
25 # Hiob 5.22; Mat 6.34 Ahoɔden ne nidie ne n’aduradeɛ,
na ɔnsuro mmerɛ a ɛwɔ n’anim.
26Ɔbue n’ano nyansa mu,
na adɔeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ne tɛkyerɛma so.
27Ɔhwɛ ne fiefoɔ korɔ-ne-ba,
na ɔnni aniha aduane.
28Ne mma sɔre, na wɔfrɛ no nhyira,
ne kunu nso, ɔyi no ayɛ sɛ.
29Mma mmaa pii ayɛ yie,
na wo deɛ, wosene wɔn nyinaa.
30 # Mmb 11.22 Osoowayɛ yɛ nnaadaa, na ahoɔfɛ yɛ ahuhudeɛ,
ɔbaa a ɔsuro AWURADE na wɔbɛyi no ayɛ.
31Momma no ne nsa ano aba bi,
na ne nneyɛɛ nyi no ayɛ kuro apono mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɔhene Lemuel nsɛm; ɔkasakyerɛ a ne na de kyerɛkyerɛɛ no.
Adɛn, me ba, na adɛn, me yafumma?
Na adɛn, me bɔhyɛ ba?
Mfa w’ahoɔden mma mmaa,
na mfa w’akwan nyɛ deɛ ɛsɛe ahemfo.
Ɛnsɛ ahemfo, Lemuel, ɛnsɛ ahemfo, sɛ wɔbɛnom nsa,
anaa atitire, sɛ wɔbɛdi nsaden akyire,
na wɔannom na wɔn werɛ amfiri mmara a wɔahyɛ,
na wɔannane amanehunufoɔ nyinaa nsɛm ani.
Fa nsaden ma deɛ ɔresɛeɛ,
ne bobesa ma awerɛhofoɔ.
Ma no nnom na ne werɛ mfiri ne hia,
na wankae n’amaneɛ bio.
Bue w’ano ma emum,
ma mma a wɔagya wɔn nyinaa asɛm.
Bue w’ano, bu atɛntenenee,
na di mmɔborɔni ne ohiani asɛm.

Ɔyepa, hwan na ɔbɛnya?
Nso ne boɔ sene nhwene pa koraa.
Ne kunu akoma da ne so,
na siadeɛ adeɛ nhia no.
Ɔyɛ no yie, na ɔnyɛ no bɔne biara,
ne nkwa nna nyinaa.
Ɔdwene kuntu ne asaawa ho,
na ɔde ne nsa yɛ adwuma fɛ so.
Ɔte sɛ odwadini ahyɛn,
ɔde n’aduane firi akyirikyiri ba.
Adeɛ nnya nkyee a, na wɔasɔre,
na wama ne fiefoɔ aduane,
na wama ne mmaawa nnwuma.
Ɔdwene afuo ho na ɔtɔ,
ɔde ne nsa ano aba yɛ bobeturo.
Ɔde ahoɔden bɔ n’asene,
na ɔhyɛ n’abasa mu den.
Ɔte ne dwumadie mu dɛ;
ne kanea nnum anadwo.
Ɔtene ne nsa sɔ ɔtadua mu,
na ne nsateaa sɔ kyekye mu.
Ɔbae ne nsam ma mmɔborɔni,
na ɔtene ne nsa ma ohiani.
Ɔnsuro sukyerɛmma mma ne fiefoɔ,
na ne fiefoɔ nyinaa firafira atankɔkɔɔ.
Wanwono mmommo afa,
ne ntoma yɛ nwera pa ne beredum.
Wɔnim ne kunu kuro apono mu,
berɛ a ɔte asase no so mpanimfoɔ mu.
Ɔpam nkamisaa na ɔtɔn,
na ɔde abɔsoɔ ma odwadini.
Ahoɔden ne nidie ne n’aduradeɛ,
na ɔnsuro mmerɛ a ɛwɔ n’anim.
Ɔbue n’ano nyansa mu,
na adɔeɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ ne tɛkyerɛma so.
Ɔhwɛ ne fiefoɔ korɔ-ne-ba,
na ɔnni aniha aduane.
Ne mma sɔre, na wɔfrɛ no nhyira,
ne kunu nso, ɔyi no ayɛ sɛ.
Mma mmaa pii ayɛ yie,
na wo deɛ, wosene wɔn nyinaa.
Osoowayɛ yɛ nnaadaa, na ahoɔfɛ yɛ ahuhudeɛ,
ɔbaa a ɔsuro AWURADE na wɔbɛyi no ayɛ.
Momma no ne nsa ano aba bi,
na ne nneyɛɛ nyi no ayɛ kuro apono mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
